searchText: Shower though: can't `TSTORE` just put the value into the regular storage cache with flag "don't ever commit this value to state". Benefits: one less hash map to keep around. No need for `TLOAD`. What will happen if we use STORE on that slot after we have set some TSTORE value? modify the value and clear the "transient" flag. It can probably work, but i like it more as separate map it is easier to discard and TSTORE/SLOAD are more distinct from SLOAD/SSTORE. My concern is key collision. The specs as written makes tstore address 0 a separate space from sstore address 0. This could be solved with richer keys, but then that's not too far removed from two maps.
